//: Ubiquitous language map used by HA6 (Single Concern). Each bounded context lists the nouns its public methods are expected to use. A member name is split into words (camelCase, snake_case, plurals folded) and matched to a concern if a keyword (or the sequence of words of a multi-word keyword) appears ANYWHERE in it, so getSlug, fetchSlug, slug() and getProductSlug are all Catalog; the most specific keyword wins, and weakConcerns only count when nothing else matches. When the name matches nothing, the member's return and parameter types are tried. Names matching no keyword (Id, Name, generic CRUD) belong to no concern. Extend this file as new bounded contexts are carved out - do not add cross-cutting keywords here, that defeats the point.
